entries.title: Software Engineer Intern, Test Engineering
entries.summary: Worked on the Test Engineering team at Major League Baseball in Summer 2026, building automated test infrastructure for MLB's MyProVenue ticketing and venue web platform — which serves 70M+ annual fans across all 30 MLB ballparks and is embedded in the Ballpark mobile app via WebViews. My primary project was building out Playwright end-to-end test suites in TypeScript/JavaScript integrated into GitHub Actions CI/CD, covering revenue-critical purchase flows like ticket vouchers, exchanges, and forwarding. I also architected an AI-assisted test generation pipeline using Claude and GPT agents (Author, Explorer, and Self-healing agents) that could auto-draft Playwright specs and Page Object Models directly from Jira tickets and product requirement documents. Additionally, I led the migration of legacy Selenium suites to Playwright across the NY, LA, and Boulder offices, achieving a 60%+ reduction in full regression runtime, and built automation scripts to provision 140+ test accounts for data setup.

entries.title: Software Engineering Consultant
entries.summary: Worked as a Software Engineering Consultant through the BU Spark! program, building a full-stack schema-mapping platform called 'ReMatch' for a client with heterogeneous SaaS data sources including ServiceNow and AuditBoard. The core AI feature was a hybrid pipeline using embeddings and LLM ranking with OpenAI to automatically match database tables, fields, and relationships across systems with confidence scoring and human-readable reasoning. I built the full stack: a visual mapping interface using React Flow for the frontend, real-time model output streaming via Server-Sent Events, Next.js backend APIs for schema introspection and matching workflows, NextAuth for Google and GitHub OAuth, and Supabase/Postgres for data storage. We delivered the prototype across four agile sprints.

entries.title: Junior Front End Development Intern
entries.summary: Worked as a Junior Front End Development Intern at PanelClaw, a solar panel mounting systems company, during Summer 2025. As essentially their first QA-focused intern, I independently researched, introduced, and implemented Cypress as the company's first automated testing framework — from scratch with no prior automation infrastructure. I rebuilt their manual front-end smoke test suite using Cypress parallel automation, cutting test execution time from a full day to about an hour (5x faster, saving 6+ engineering hours daily). I also wrote and maintained hundreds of Jest JavaScript unit tests for backend coverage and leveraged GitHub Copilot to accelerate development.

entries.title: TaskApp (Web + Mobile)
entries.tagline: AI-powered productivity platform with cross-platform task management and intelligent prioritization
entries.summary: TaskApp is my flagship personal project — a full-stack, cross-platform task management system with a Next.js web app and a React Native iOS mobile app. Tasks sync across devices via Firebase. Key features: a drag-and-drop Eisenhower Matrix for prioritization, AI-powered task creation from natural language and voice input using Azure OpenAI GPT-4o, native iOS widgets via Swift/WidgetKit, live iCal calendar feeds, and automated CI/CD builds using EAS and Fastlane. Currently supports 500+ users and 2000+ tasks. Available on the App Store.

entries.title: InternAtlas
entries.tagline: Search thousands of tech company job boards in one place, with filtering and automated updates
entries.summary: InternAtlas is a job aggregation platform I built and shipped in December 2025–January 2026. It crawls 3,100+ tech companies across 5 ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, etc.) and normalizes 1,650,000+ internship job listings into a unified PostgreSQL schema for large-scale labor market search. Features a live Next.js frontend on Vercel with real-time full-text search and advanced filters, and automated daily data refreshes via GitHub Actions. PostgreSQL database hosted on DigitalOcean.
